name: Delayed tilt (2 stages)
description: Planar layers tilted about X. The layers stay flat until the first offset (t = 0..1 is the layer position), then the tilt grows linearly to Tilt 1; after the second offset it grows further, by Extra tilt, to the end. Set Extra tilt to 0 for a single delayed bend. Offsets are fractions of the layer stack (0.4 = from 40 % of the part height).
tilt_x_deg: tilt1_deg * clip((t - start1) / maximum(end1 - start1, 0.001), 0, 1) + extra_tilt_deg * clip((t - start2) / maximum(end2 - start2, 0.001), 0, 1)

start1.label: Bend 1 start
start1.description: Layer position (0..1) where the first tilt begins

end1.label: Bend 1 end
end1.description: Layer position where Tilt 1 is reached

tilt1_deg.label: Tilt 1
tilt1_deg.description: Tilt reached after the first bend

start2.label: Bend 2 start
start2.description: Layer position where the second tilt begins

end2.label: Bend 2 end
end2.description: Layer position where the second tilt is complete

extra_tilt_deg.label: Extra tilt
extra_tilt_deg.description: Additional tilt added by the second bend (total = Tilt 1 + Extra tilt)
